richiesta: Grafiche diverse per ogni capitolo, generate con imagegen.
modalita: strumento integrato image_gen, una generazione per capitolo
prompt_comune: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original editorial illustration for a chapter opener in an Italian university booklet on visual communication and interface design. Create a distinctive sophisticated conceptual artwork, not a diagram, stock icon or UI mockup. Consistent family: striking graphic composition, charcoal-black ink, white/ivory cut-paper elements, subtle tactile print grain and crisp high-contrast silhouettes. Carefully balanced asymmetric mass and generous negative space. Art only, no border, no panel, no surrounding paper rectangle, no typography, no words, no numbers, no labels, no logos or watermark. The chapter title and number will be added as native editable text outside the artwork. Square canvas, isolated self-contained composition, nothing clipped at edges. Real transparent background; preserve clean alpha. Do not use subway lines, route maps or metro motifs.

capitoli.soggetto: A poetic three-dimensional collage: a flowing charcoal ink gesture enters a folded ivory paper form, then emerges as an intentionally composed small printed image. The meeting of gesture, shape and purposeful communication. One strong central folded form, a few purposeful surrounding fragments, no literal hands, no readable lettering. Mostly black and ivory.

An original editorial still-life of three timeless designed objects from different eras: a metal movable-type printing block, a bent tubular-steel chair seen in profile, and a simple hand-sized contemporary glass-screen object. Organize them in an evocative ascending diagonal composition, linked through form and material, not a timeline. No specific trademark, no imitation of any famous branded product. Monochrome black and ivory, tactile collage.

capitoli.soggetto: A single continuous folded ivory paper ribbon that loops back, opens, gets revised and converges into a clearer purposeful structure. Ink trial marks and one translucent paper overlay suggest iteration, exploration and testing. Elegant sculptural editorial metaphor, not a flowchart, no arrows or route-map appearance. Black and ivory.

capitoli.soggetto: A cluster of layered viewfinder-like paper apertures, each revealing a different partial view of the same small everyday space, with three subtle abstract human silhouettes of varied proportions. The overlapping viewpoints assemble a richer understanding of context. Sophisticated observational editorial collage, no magnifying-glass icon, no data dashboard, black and ivory.

capitoli.soggetto: An inviting sculptural assemblage with one shared central paper form approachable through several equally prominent tactile, visual and gestural interfaces. Include an embossed dot texture, a large open grip-like curve and a bold contrasting opening, integrated as one elegant composition. Visual metaphor for different ways to participate, not a medical diagram. Do not reduce accessibility to a wheelchair symbol; no disabled-person caricatures. Black and ivory.

capitoli.soggetto: Many small irregular translucent paper observations concentrate into one sharply defined large opening cut in a solid folded ivory sheet. The empty opening is the focal point, expressing a clear problem framed from evidence. Avoid funnels, lightbulb icons and literal question marks. Quiet but decisive editorial composition, black and ivory.

Figure-ground ambiguity and closure as a poetic visual experience, not a labeled textbook demonstration. Do not copy the Rubin vase, Kanizsa triangle or a known optical illusion. Black and ivory.

Their relationships suggest that context turns a mark into meaning. Create a distinctive rhythmic call-and-response composition with varied scale, avoiding alphabet characters, logos and generic pictogram sheets. Black and ivory.

Rich asymmetrical editorial rhythm with evident first, second and third levels, not a pyramid, not a bar chart. Strong scale contrast, black and ivory.

capitoli.soggetto: A sculptural editorial still-life of overlapping translucent colored acetate and matte folded-paper forms. Cyan, magenta, warm yellow, blue and orange create visible interactions and nuanced overlaps, while a single charcoal element anchors the composition. Colors retain distinct identities and mixed intersections, no rainbow wheel, no UI swatches, no labels. Sophisticated print-design aesthetic.

capitoli.soggetto: An expressive sculptural collage made from cropped letterform-like strokes: one heavy rounded black bowl, a delicate serif-like wedge, a tall stem and a counter-space cut through an ivory sheet. These are abstract type anatomy fragments, not readable letters or words. Dramatic scale and optical rhythm. Include a restrained pale blue #AFC7E8 paper element consistent with the existing Typography chapter accent.

An elegant physical composition of folded ivory paper planes and charcoal printed planes organized by shared invisible alignments. One larger plane breaks the rhythm purposefully while still aligning at a clear edge; spatial intervals are the main expressive material. A restrained sage #A5BDB0 translucent plane uses the existing Grid chapter accent. No wireframe, no printed guide grid, no graph paper, no architectural city, no route-map pattern.

motivo_rifiuto: L’utente ha richiesto illustrazioni piatte vettoriali nel colore del capitolo; la proposta collage non viene usata nel booklet.
